sources.title: K2 Horizon 3.7B - 524k context, open source | LLM Reference
sources.snippet: K2-Horizon-3.7B is a small dense K2 Horizon decoder-only model: 3.7B parameters, 512K native context, and Apache 2.0 weights on Hugging Face (IFM/K2-Horizon-3.7B). Part of IFM's six-model open fleet alongside larger MoE and dense siblings.

sources.title: Introducing K2 Horizon: Frontier Performance, Radically Open - ifm.ai
sources.snippet: Together, K2 Horizon represents the most comprehensive open model release to date: A new performance frontier across scales. The 0.9B, 3.7B, and 7B models achieve world-leading performance in their size classes across widely used evaluations.

sources.title: IFM/K2-Horizon-3.7B | vLLM Recipes - recipes.vllm.ai
sources.snippet: Overview K2-Horizon-3.7B is a small dense model in the IFM K2-Horizon family, with 5.06B stored parameters including embeddings and support for up to 524,288 tokens of context.
